items.title: Arthur Baron interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 3, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: Jon Faddis used to say to me, “Why don’t you play with your own kind?”

ctx.x: Well, as I told you earlier, my wife who is also a Caucasian from Norway, who has never seen anything like this except on the news, and she doesn’t want to march, and I understand it because it’s really dangerous with the virus too, and I’ve got my feelings about that, I’m not sure, but she worked on it yesterday and she came home and told me, and she’s a bit shy, she gave me an idea that she wanted me to initiate, and I would have initiated it but I really wanted her to. She said, “Let’s call up all our black or…
Yeah, we have a path sort of.
